_readme: Window lines are based on Beacon Building Products / QXO's public catalog (becn.com and qxo.com) where beaconListing is filled in. Lines marked confirmWithBranch are the same brands Beacon distributes, but the exact series should be confirmed with the Beacon branch before ordering. Prices are NOT in this file — edit data/pricing.json. Frame-color lists are editable placeholders and should match what each series actually offers.

types.name: Single hung
types.blurb: Bottom sash slides up. A clean fit for bedrooms, baths, and older LA bungalows.

types.name: Double hung
types.blurb: Both sashes move and tilt in. The classic look on Spanish and traditional homes.

types.name: Slider
types.blurb: Sashes glide side to side. Easy to open over a kitchen sink or along a patio wall.

types.name: Casement
types.blurb: Cranks open outward and seals tight against the marine layer and canyon winds.

types.name: Awning
types.blurb: Hinged at the top so it can stay open when a light rain blows in.

types.name: Picture
types.blurb: A fixed pane for the view. Pair it with a hung or casement window beside it.

types.name: Bay & bow
types.blurb: A projecting window that adds a seat, a little floor area, and a wider view.

types.name: Garden
types.blurb: A glass box with a shelf for plants, usually over the kitchen sink.

types.name: Specialty shapes
types.blurb: Half rounds, arches, and circles for entries, gables, and Craftsman details.

types.name: Patio doors
types.blurb: Sliding glass doors that open the living room to a yard, balcony, or deck.

tiers.name: Good
tiers.blurb: Solid vinyl for a straightforward replacement. Low-E glass, simple colors.

tiers.name: Better
tiers.blurb: Stronger lines and more glass or color choices for most whole-home projects.

tiers.name: Best
tiers.blurb: The premium vinyl we order when the opening is the one guests notice.

grids.name: Colonial
grids.blurb: Even panes. The familiar divided look.

grids.name: Prairie
grids.blurb: A line set in from the edge. Quiet and Craftsman.

glass.name: Dual-pane Low-E
glass.blurb: Standard. Two panes with a Low-E coating for heat and UV.

glass.name: Solar-control Low-E
glass.blurb: Tighter solar heat gain for west and south glass.

glass.name: Triple-pane Low-E
glass.blurb: A third pane for quieter rooms near a boulevard.

glass.name: Tempered safety glass
glass.blurb: Where the opening is near a door, the floor, or a tub.

glass.name: Obscure
glass.blurb: Privacy glass for baths and side yards.

products.name: MI Windows V2000 Single Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public window catalog as the V2000 Series Model 3500 vinyl single-hung with Low-E glass.
products.description: A value vinyl single hung with a tilting bottom sash and Low-E glass. Beacon lists this V2000 Model 3500 in common stock sizes. A practical bedroom and rental window.

products.name: Atrium 150 Tilt Single Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as Atrium Windows and Doors Series 150 Tilt Single Hung.
products.description: Atrium's Series 150 tilt single hung. The sash tilts in for cleaning, and the vinyl frame stays low maintenance in the marine air.

products.name: Simonton Contractor Single Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public catalog as Simonton Contractor Single Hung, including grid, tempered, and triple-pane variants.
products.description: Simonton's contractor single hung, the line Beacon shows with grids, tempered glass, and a triple-pane option. A step up for street-facing rooms.

products.name: Ply Gem Double Hung with Nail Fin
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as Ply Gem double hung windows with nail fins in several stock sizes.
products.description: A vinyl double hung with a nailing fin, the stock unit Beacon lists for new openings and full-frame replacements. Both sashes are built to tilt.

products.name: Ply Gem 5000 Series Double Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as the Ply Gem 5000 Series double hung (example size 38 in × 51 in).
products.description: Ply Gem's 5000 Series double hung. A thicker vinyl profile than the builder stock units, with Low-E glass and colonial or prairie grids.

products.name: Paradigm Society 2 Double Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public catalog as Paradigm Window Solutions Society 2 double hung with full screen.
products.description: Paradigm's Society 2 replacement double hung, shown on Beacon with a full screen. The line we use when the front elevation needs a finer sash.

products.name: Paradigm Versatec Twin Double Hung
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public catalog as Paradigm Versatec twin double hung with Low-E and flat grids.
products.description: Two double-hung units mulled as one wide opening. Beacon lists the Versatec twin with Low-E glass and flat grids. Measured as one opening.

products.name: Ply Gem 2000 Series 2-Lite Slider
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public catalog as the Ply Gem 2000 Series 2-lite slider vinyl window.
products.description: A two-lite vinyl slider from Ply Gem's 2000 Series. One sash glides past the other. Useful over counters and on side walls.

products.name: Ply Gem 2000 Series 3-Lite Slider
products.beaconListing: Same Ply Gem 2000 Series family as the 2-lite slider Beacon lists. Confirm the 3-lite configuration with your branch.
products.description: The wider three-lite configuration of the Ply Gem 2000 slider family. The center is fixed or the ends slide, depending on the handing you choose at order.

products.name: Simonton Vinyl Slider
products.beaconListing: Beacon's public catalog lists Simonton hung and picture windows. The vinyl slider is part of that Simonton offering — confirm the series in stock at your branch.
products.description: A premium vinyl horizontal slider from Simonton, the brand Beacon already shows in its contractor and builder window listings. Confirm the exact slider series when you order.

products.name: MI Windows V3000 Casement
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as the V3000 Series Model 9770 vinyl casement, left- or right-handed, with Low-E glass.
products.description: MI's V3000 casement, model 9770. It cranks out to catch a breeze and the sash pulls tight when you close it. Handing is chosen at order.

products.name: Ply Gem Pro Series Casement
products.beaconListing: Listed on the QXO/Beacon public catalog as the Ply Gem Pro Series casement window.
products.description: Ply Gem's Pro Series casement. A finer frame and a stronger seal than the builder casements, with Low-E glass and optional prairie grids.

products.name: Ply Gem Vinyl Awning
products.beaconListing: Beacon lists Ply Gem's Pro Series casement and 5000 Series hung windows. The awning is the top-hinged companion in that vinyl family — confirm the awning SKU with your branch.
products.description: A top-hinged vinyl awning from the Ply Gem lines Beacon carries. It sheds a light rain while it vents, which suits baths and clerestory openings.

products.name: Simonton Builder Picture
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as Simonton Builder picture windows, including grid and tempered sizes.
products.description: A fixed picture window from Simonton's builder line. Beacon lists it with grids and in tempered glass. All view, no moving parts.

products.name: Paradigm Craftec Picture
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as Paradigm Craftec picture windows, including multi-lite sizes.
products.description: Paradigm's Craftec picture window, the fixed unit Beacon lists beside its Craftec hung windows. Use it alone or between two operating windows.

products.name: Atrium 150 Half Round
products.beaconListing: Listed on the Beacon public catalog as the Atrium Series 150 half round window.
products.description: A half-round from Atrium's Series 150, the shape Beacon lists. It sits over a door or a double hung. Width is the diameter and height is half of that, roughly.

products.name: Arch & Quarter-Round
products.beaconListing: Beacon lists the Atrium Series 150 half round. Eyebrow arches, quarter rounds, and circles are the rest of that geometric family — confirm the shape with your branch.
products.description: An arched or quarter-round vinyl shape from the same Atrium geometric family as the half round Beacon lists. Tell us the shape in your notes and we confirm the unit before it is ordered.

products.name: Three-Section Vinyl Bay
products.beaconListing: Assembled from Beacon-supplied Paradigm or Ply Gem hung and picture units. Beacon lists those units individually. Confirm the bay mullion kit with your branch.
products.description: A three-section bay: operating windows on the angles and a picture window in the center, mulled from the Paradigm and Ply Gem lines Beacon stocks. Measured as one opening, outside jamb to outside jamb.

products.name: Four-Section Vinyl Bow
products.beaconListing: A bow assembly of the vinyl hung and picture lines Beacon distributes (Paradigm, Ply Gem). Confirm section count and projection with your branch.
products.description: A gentler bow, usually four sections, for a dining nook or a front room. Built from the same Beacon vinyl lines as the bay. The price is for the whole assembly.

products.name: Vinyl Garden Window
products.beaconListing: Garden windows are part of the Ply Gem and Simonton vinyl programs Beacon distributes. Confirm the shelf depth and series with your branch.
products.description: A projecting garden window with a shelf, usually over the sink. Glass on the front and both sides, ordered through the Ply Gem and Simonton lines Beacon carries.

products.name: Two-Panel Vinyl Patio Slider
products.beaconListing: Beacon distributes Simonton and Ply Gem. Both brands build vinyl sliding patio doors. Confirm which patio series your branch stocks.
products.description: A two-panel vinyl sliding patio door. One panel operates. Low-E glass is standard in this estimate. A common swap for a tired aluminum slider.

products.name: Three-Panel Vinyl Patio Slider
products.beaconListing: Three-panel vinyl patio doors from the Ply Gem and Simonton lines Beacon distributes. Confirm the panel stack and pocket options with your branch.
products.description: A wider three-panel vinyl slider for the back of the house. The center is typically fixed and one or both ends move. Measured as the full frame.
